en: Black-and-white postcard showing a long rectangular two‑storey building on a hillside, identified as the municipal hospital of Xanthi. The structure has many windows, simple neoclassical lines, and a small central entrance projection. There are hills in the background and rough, undeveloped terrain in the foreground. Printed captions in Greek and French appear below the image, and a web address is faintly watermarked across the lower right.
